newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs tumble on bearish EIA data.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs tumble on bearish EIA data.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices tumbled in moderate activity on Thursday following the late Wednesday release of bearish inventory data for propane.
The Energy Information Administration report recorded a hefty 7.9 million barrel gain last month to 40 million barrels as of May 31. Propane stocks are now about 26 percent above year-ago levels.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane fell a half cent to see deals done at 33.75 cents and 34.00 cents a gallon.
Conway, Kansas, material traded as low as 35.00 cents, 1.25 cents below Wednesday.
"The EIAs were pretty bearish," said one Houston player. "But people were expecting the builds."
Belvieu normal butane was also down about a penny to 38.75 cents and Conway material traded 37.50/37.75 cents.
Belvieu ethane purity was pegged 18.75/19.00 cents, with Conway at 16.75/17.00 cents, traders said.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
